relevance_note: Single-patient case report of Tangier disease with an ABCA1 variant: 'the patient was homozygous for a novel ~3.5 kb deletion'.
method_note: Read in full and transcribed by hand; a short Python script assembled the JSON and checked spans. No tables in the paper; the supplementary file is an image only. Label: the paper labels its patient '#Mo-4' (also printed '# Mo.4' and '#Mo.4' in figure legends); '#Mo-4' is the most frequent form, so rule 1 applies. In scope also: the previously published patient of reference [5] (38-year-old female, homozygous ABCA1 intron 32 acceptor splice-site mutation, dysarthria, ataxic gait, peripheral neuropathy, no orange tonsils), labelled 'ref [5] patient'. Out of scope: 'TDPK', a Tangier control patient from reference [4] whose fibroblasts were used only as an assay control (no individual-level fact beyond diagnosis). Age 58 years is the age at referral to RCCRD in 2010, before at least ~19 months of reported follow-up, so age at last evaluation is left not reported for #Mo-4; ages at TD or NPC diagnosis are not stated. Age at onset taken from the earliest reported features (thrombocytopenia and splenomegaly since age 32). The deletion is printed 'c.4464-486_4698 + 382 Del (Ex32_Ex34del)', which the paper calls the genomic-level designation but writes in c. notation; recorded as cDNA, genomic field left null. Variant type recorded as 'large deletion/CNV' (authors: '~3.5 kb deletion' of exons 32-34); the authors also describe the protein effect as an in-frame deletion of 77 amino acids. Normal findings recorded per D-27: 'brain MRI was negative', 'neurological examination was negative', 'EMG of upper and lower limbs was normal' and 'brain angio-MRI was normal' are whole investigations and exclude only the abnormality they name; the neurological examination and EMG were normal after 6 months of miglustat, after earlier abnormal findings (reported regression on treatment, not a contradiction), so the checklist keeps peripheral neuropathy observed. Tonsils: 'normal in size and color' (on miglustat) plus 'did not have orange tonsils' exclude the composite tonsil item for #Mo-4; for the ref [5] patient only orange colour is addressed, so that checklist item stays not reported. Lipid accumulation in Schwann cells of cutaneous nerves (skin biopsy) was not counted as 'skin lipid deposits' in the checklist. Total cholesterol is low but LDL is not reported. No contradictions found in the paper.
